$comment: Secrets this piece takes only when the estate deploys their consumer (tools/bundle/identity-components.mjs). mesh: the Tailscale operator's credentials, only with a hosted Tailscale tailnet: TAILNET_DOMAIN set in the identity (*.ts.net). Where it is not set the loader derives it as the mesh's own domain, and the operator is not deployed (tools/bundle/mesh-pieces.mjs). kutt: the link shortener's sign-in client in authentik-oidc-clients, only for an estate whose PLATFORM_APPS lists kutt.
